conditional_envelope.identity: On each smooth stationary branch dE/dQ=Omega. Virial gives E-Omega Q=(2/3)K>0, so d(E/Q)/dQ=-(2K)/(3Q^2)<0. If every allowed lower-charge component in the found continuous envelope has E(q)/q >= E(Qstar)/Qstar and free carriers cost1, every positive-charge partition drawn from that envelope costs at least E(Qstar). Missing states/branches are not excluded.
conditional_envelope.conditional_statement: For positive-charge components from the continuous branches found here with 0<q<=Qstar, if no unobserved lower-energy state intervenes, e(q)=E(q)/q >= e(Qstar). Free same-sign X carriers have e=1. Therefore any such partition sums to energy >= E(Qstar). The finite scan does not prove completeness of these branches or control arbitrary field configurations, nonspherical states, opposite-charge creation, or quantum channels.
conditional_envelope.no_uniform_gap_for_arbitrarily_small_fre: A lump of charge Qstar-dq plus free charge dq approaches the original energy as dq->0; first order cost is (1-Omega_star)*dq.
